messages:
sophia: Onboarding note: brought peregrine-v0 (quant q5) into staging and the smoke suite flagged several locale-specific regressions: Korean honorific / politeness suffixes dropping, Chinese spelled numerals turning into ASCII digits, and Arabic RTL punctuation spacing breaking (comma attaching to LTR side). Anyone seen a similar pack of symptoms? @li-wei @sanjay

li-wei: Noted. Can you paste a minimal curl repro and the eval harness command you ran?

sophia: Minimal repro (single-line curl): curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $EVAL_KEY" -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"model":"peregrine-v0-q5","input":"선생님께서 말씀하셨습니다: 감사합니다.","max_tokens":32,"temperature":0}'
Observed staging output: 선생님 말했어: 고마워.  <-- polite suffix lost, output downgraded to informal

Chinese example: input: 订单号一二三四，请确认。 output: 订单号1234，请确认。  <-- spelled numerals collapsed to digits

Arabic example: input: مرحباً، هل يمكنك المساعدة؟ output: مرحباً ,هل يمكنك المساعدة؟  <-- stray space before comma and comma appears on LTR side

qa-bot: Auto-eval snapshot: ko-politeness BLEU delta -2.9; cn-numeral CER +1.8; ar-rtl-punct F1 -12%

sanjay: Hypotheses: (A) tokenizer/vocab mismatch between model bundle and staging runtime causing different subtokenization (honorifics split); (B) quantization merged low-frequency suffix vectors reducing logits; (C) detokenizer/normalize regressions affecting RTL punctuation placement.

mina: FYI the model bundle includes tokenizer_v2.2.json but staging defaults to tokenizer_v2.0 unless manifest pins it. That would easily explain subtoken shifts. Arabic punctuation oddness smells like the detok library change we merged last week.

li-wei: Can you run a quick tokenization diff locally: new=tokenizer_v2.2.json, old=tokenizer_v2.0.json, then encode the Korean sample and compare token lists around the honorific suffix? If tokens differ, pin tokenizer in manifest and rerun smoke.

sophia: Doing that now. Also re-invoking generation with ?trace=true to collect token trace + logits around suspicious tokens. Will post traces here.

mina: Action items: 1) enforce tokenizer.json sha + vocab.tsv in model bundle and assert during load (I will open a PR to add the check). 2) If tokenization pin fixes KO/CN but AR persists, run a bisect on detokenizer package (we have a recent CL touching Arabic spacing rules). 3) If tokenization pin doesn't fix KO, run quantization parity checks comparing logits for suffix tokens pre/post q5 compaction.

sophia: Quick update (~15m): pinned tokenizer_v2.2 in manifest and rerun smoke: Korean politeness preserved, Chinese numerals preserved as spelled forms. Arabic punctuation still misattached. Looks like a separate detok regression. Will bisect detok and paste ?trace=true output for the Arabic sample.

li-wei: Perfect. If you include token traces and logits I can run a short diagnostic to see if it's decode-side only or if the model logits already favor the wrong spacing.

sophia: Will do shortly and update thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:
